effort_detail: Higher thinks more carefully and takes longer. auto uses the model default. To use max for every new Agent, set it in Model configuration › Agents › Reasoning effort. For a single session, use the session effort control or /effort max.
effort_max_ignored: Saved max is not applied: Claude Code ignores it in settings.json and uses the model default. To use max for every new Agent, set it in Model configuration › Agents › Reasoning effort. For a single session, use the session effort control or /effort max.
